name: Monthly Sales Forecast
query:
SELECT
    DATE(o.close_date) as "Closed Date",
    SUM(o.forecast_revenue) as "Forecast Revenue" 
FROM 
    `tabOpportunity` o
JOIN
    `tabUser` u
ON
    o.opportunity_owner = u.email
WHERE 
    YEAR(o.close_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(o.close_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND u.enabled = 1
GROUP BY
    o.close_date;
